scope: Nine full sparse Poisson GPU trials: three per 100^3/4GPU,150^3/4GPU,200^3/8GPU layout, at the two user-requested tolerances.
source_changes: None; reuse immutable validated numerical build.

selected_configuration.reason: Streams4 pilots showed no material benefit; streams1 needs less workspace. Larger local exact subtrees were admitted in whole GPU batches.

accuracy_policy.criterion: Actual finite final refinement stopping condition and normal finite complete solver output, not launcher exit alone.

metrics.refinement_absolute_residual: MPI-global Frobenius norm over all three RHS
metrics.refinement_relative_residual: MPI-global Frobenius residual divided by initial residual norm, all three RHS

legacy_strict_accuracy_policy.scope: Informational comparison only; does not reject the requested looser stopping tolerance.

baseline_comparison.scope: Both compression and solver tolerance differ; retain accuracy/performance tradeoff.

allocation_attempts_without_solver_cases.reason: Immediate60 requests expired before allocation; no solver cases; excluded from numerical trial counts.

runtime_evidence.scheduling_note: 200 second bounded request granted;150 retained queued after two immediate expirations;100 granted on first request after150 finished.

acceptance.required: finite/nonnegative norms and errors, normal exit, final REFINE iteration matches reported count and<=maxit; absres<=1e-12 OR relres<=1e-6 OR backwarderror<=1e-12 with1e-5 relative print rounding allowance; actual tolerances reported mustmatch
acceptance.source: IterativeRefinementMPI.cpp stopping predicate; independent audit before any runs
